description: Source code for the 'dumpsys' utility in Android, handling service dumping, including listing services, dumping specific service info (PID, stability, threads, clients), and managing dump threads with timeout handling.

classes.name: Dumpsys
classes.description: Main class implementing the dumpsys utility functions, including service listing, dumping, and thread management.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for the dumpsys utility, parsing command-line arguments, listing services, and initiating dumps.

methods.name: listServices
methods.description: Lists available services, optionally filtering by priority and proto support.

methods.name: setServiceArgs
methods.description: Prepares argument list for dumping a specific service, adding flags based on priority and proto options.

methods.name: startDumpThread
methods.description: Starts a thread to dump information from a specified service, redirecting output via pipes.

methods.name: stopDumpThread
methods.description: Stops the dump thread, joining or detaching as appropriate.

methods.name: writeDumpHeader
methods.description: Writes a header before dumping service info, including service name and priority.

methods.name: writeDump
methods.description: Performs the dump operation with timeout handling, reading from pipe and writing to output.

methods.name: writeDumpFooter
methods.description: Writes footer after dump, including duration and timestamp.
